title: Warbreaker
summary: On Nalthis, magic is fueled by BioChromatic Breath—a resource that can be given away, collected, and used to Awaken objects and command the Lifeless. Princess Vivenna of Idris has trained her entire life for her destiny: to marry the God-King of T'Telir and secure peace for her people. But when her younger sister Siri is sent in her place, both sisters must navigate a dangerous world of divine politics, assassination plots, and the mysteries of the Court of Gods. The immortal Returned god Lightsong questions his own purpose while a mysterious warrior named Vasher—carrying the sentient, soul-devouring sword Nightblood—hunts through the city with his own agenda. The nature of divinity, sacrifice, and what it truly means to give Breath are explored in this standalone tale of two sisters caught in a gods' war.
archiveDescription: This record concerns the world of Nalthis and its unique system of BioChromatic investiture, wherein Breath—a resource that can be voluntarily transferred between individuals—serves as both currency and source of Awakening. The narrative follows the political tensions between the mountain kingdom of Idris and the lowland nation of Hallandren, where Returned gods govern mortal affairs. The volume documents the nature of the Lifeless, the ethical dimensions of Breath commerce, and the existence of a sentient, investiture-devouring weapon of considerable power. The events recorded here have implications for understanding the nature of divine investiture across the Cosmere.
